en.headline: Hang Seng Index opens 1.14% higher at 24,139
en.dek: Hong Kong stocks rose at the open on Wednesday following gains on Wall Street, with the benchmark topping 24,000 points.
body: Hong Kong’s Hang Seng Index rose 271 points, or 1.14 per cent, to open at 24,139 on Wednesday.

Local and regional stocks advanced following Wall Street’s gains as early indications from the corporate earnings season pointed to strong profits for global companies and bolstered investor confidence, according to market reports.

The Shanghai Composite Index opened 0.14 per cent higher, while Japan’s Nikkei 225 climbed 1.3 per cent. Analysts noted that stocks in the region had steadied since a sell-off last week but had traded in a tight range.

zh.headline: 恒生指數高開271點報24139
zh.dek: 港股周三高開，跟隨美股升勢，基準指數重上24000點。
body: 恒生指數周三高開271點，或1.14%，報24139點。
本地及區內股市跟隨美股升勢上揚，市場報道指企業盈利季初期跡象顯示環球公司盈利強勁，提振投資者信心。
上證綜合指數高開0.14%，日經225指數則升1.3%。分析指區內股市自上周拋售後已趨穩，但仍在窄幅波動。
